impact: Encrypts victims' files and demands ransom for file decryption
mitigation_measures: Keep all AV and IPS signatures up to date
Leverage phishing simulation services like FortiPhish
Implement advanced endpoint security solutions like EDR
Adopt Zero Trust Access and network segmentation strategies
Use cloud-based security solutions such as SASE
Avoid paying ransom as per guidance from CISA, NCSC, FBI, and HHS
